propositions: The _no_repo_commits autouse guard calls git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, adding ~207 runner-seconds per full suite (75s projected wall saving on macOS).

Replacing two per-test Git subprocesses with in-process HEAD fingerprint requires discovering the worktree Git directory once per worker and handling symbolic loose refs, packed refs, detached HEAD, and linked worktrees.

Consensus research across pytest, pip, Poetry, and pre-commit shows 4/4 projects avoid per-test source-checkout Git subprocesses, but no fidelity-preserving implementation primitive (Git library, hand-parsing, or guard removal) meets the session checkout-attribution contract.
The per-test contract must preserve exact checkout HEAD move detection, individual test naming in failures, allow_repo_writes escape hatch, and session-wide dirty-tree backstop unchanged.
No Git library addition, hand-ref-parsing implementation, or guard removal is automatically approved without explicit operator design choice or new evidence for a safe primitive.
